title: Gas Station
statement_short: There are n gas stations along a circular route, where the gas at the i-th station is gas[i] and the cost to travel to the next station is cost[i]. Return the starting gas station's index if you can travel around the circuit once in the clockwise direction, otherwise return -1.
constraints: n == gas.length == cost.length, 1 <= n <= 10^5, 0 <= gas[i], cost[i] <= 10^4
hint: n up to 10^5 dictates an O(n) single pass, resetting the starting station whenever cumulative tank balance drops below zero.
why_not: Right: Greedy checks if total gas >= total cost and advances the candidate start index past any station where running gas balance turns negative in O(n) time. Not Graph BFS: Simulating full circular traversals from every node takes O(n^2) time. Not Sliding Window: The circular traversal length is fixed to n rather than finding a variable subsegment. Not 2D DP: Multi-dimensional state tracking is unnecessary for cumulative net balance evaluation.
